mapper.insert: INSERT INTO w18_module_owned_draft (reservation_key, buyer_kind, buyer_id, target_draft_id, target_revision, revision, state, review_status, publish_status, is_sync, source_content, terms_document, frozen_rights, installed_by, installed_at) VALUES (#{reservationKey}, #{buyerKind}, #{buyerId}, #{targetDraftId}, #{targetRevision}, 1, 'DRAFT', 0, 0, 0, #{sourceContent}, #{termsDocument}, #{rightsJson}, #{installedBy}, #{installedAt})
INSERT INTO w18_module_draft_component (draft_id, local_key, component_kind, schema_version, content_json) VALUES (#{id}, 'template', 'TEXT_TEMPLATE', 1, #{contentJson})
INSERT INTO w18_module_install_usage (reservation_key, owned_draft_id, committed_at) VALUES (#{key}, #{draftId}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.reservation_key, d.buyer_kind, d.buyer_id, d.target_draft_id, d.target_revision, u.committed_at FROM w18_module_owned_draft d JOIN w18_module_install_usage u ON u.owned_draft_id = d.id AND u.reservation_key = d.reservation_key WHERE d.reservation_key = #{key} AND d.buyer_kind = #{buyerKind} AND d.buyer_id = #{buyerId} FOR UPDATE
